name: Hotel Auffacherhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Auffacherhof welcomes holidaymakers to the charming village district of Auffach in Tyrol's scenic high valley of Wildschönau. This traditional four-star establishment provides cosy alpine country-style guest rooms and suites equipped with contemporary en-suite bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, Wi-Fi, and sunny balconies framing views of the Kitzbühel Alps. Following outdoor pursuits, the on-site spa area featuring an indoor pool, Finnish sauna, steam room, and infrared cabin invites guests to unwind. In the dining room, a nutritious morning breakfast buffet packed with regional specialities is served, complemented by authentic Tyrolean dinners in the evening. The lower gondola station of the Schatzbergbahn, gateway into the expansive Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau ski domain, is just a few steps away. In summer, hikes to the Schatzberg and the Schönangeralm pastures start right outside.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy traditional hotel in Auffach in the Wildschönau with an indoor pool, saunas, and right by the Schatzbergbahn.
